svg.title: A Zircolite run in the terminal
svg.desc: Recorded output of python3 zircolite.py on sample_bitsadmin.evtx with the merged Windows ruleset: 4515 rules load, the event filter and log type are set up, one event is processed, and the medium rule File Download Via Bitsadmin - Sysmon matches and is written to detected_events.json.

text.tspan: -= Standalone Sigma Detection tool for EVTX/Auditd/Sysmon Linux =-
